049/**
050 * x
051 */
052public class RowSetOps_NOT_USED {
053  private static final Logger logger = JStuff.getLogger();
054
055  /**
056   * Method used by RowSet listeners to get the new text when the RowSet
057   * events are triggered.
058   *
059   * @param comp this components rowset/column text
060   *
061   * @return text representation of data in specified column
062   * @see <a href="https://download.oracle.com/otn-pub/jcp/jdbc-4_3-mrel3-eval-spec/jdbc4.3-fr-spec.pdf">JDBC 4.3 Specification</a> Appendix B
063   */
064  public static String getColumnText_NOT_USED(SsComponent comp) {
065    final RowSet rowSet = comp.getRowSet();
066    final int cIdx = comp.getColumnIndex();
067    String value = null;
068
069    try {
070      // If the column is null, return null.
071      if ((RowSetOps.getColumnCount(rowSet) == 0) || (rowSet.getObject(cIdx) == null)) {
072        return null;
073      }
074
075      final JDBCType jdbcType = ConvertType.getJDBCType(RowSetOps.getColumnType(rowSet, cIdx));
076
077      // Based on the column data type convert column's value to a String.
078      value = switch (jdbcType) {
079        case INTEGER, SMALLINT, TINYINT -> String.valueOf(rowSet.getInt(cIdx));
080        case BIGINT -> String.valueOf(rowSet.getLong(cIdx));
081        case REAL -> String.valueOf(rowSet.getFloat(cIdx));
082        case DOUBLE, FLOAT -> String.valueOf(rowSet.getDouble(cIdx));
083        case NUMERIC, DECIMAL -> String.valueOf(rowSet.getBigDecimal(cIdx));
084        case BIT, BOOLEAN -> String.valueOf(rowSet.getBoolean(cIdx));
085        case DATE, TIME, TIMESTAMP -> DateTime.getDateTimeText(comp);
086        case CHAR, VARCHAR, LONGVARCHAR, NCHAR, NVARCHAR, LONGNVARCHAR -> {
087          String str = rowSet.getString(cIdx);
088          yield str == null ? "" : str;
089        }
090        default -> {
091          // TODO: SSSQLExceptionUnhandledType
092          logger.log(
093              ERROR,
094              () -> sf("Unsupported data type of %s for column %d.", jdbcType.getName(), cIdx));
095          yield null;
096        }
097      }; // end switch
098    } catch (final SQLException se) {
099      logger.log(ERROR, "SQL Exception for column " + cIdx + ".", se);
100    }
101    return value;
102
103  } // end protected String getColumnText(RowSet rs, String _columnName) {
104
105  /**
106   * Returns an Object of the specified type
107   * representing the value in the component's bound database column.
108   * @param <T> type to return
109   * @param comp component
110   * @param type Class of returned type
111   * @return value
112   */
113  static <T> T getColumnObject2(RSC comp, Class<T> type) throws SQLException {
114    return comp.getRowSet().getObject(comp.getColumnIndex(), type);
115  }
116
117  //
118  // This switch code is the original from SSDataGrid/SSTableModel,
119  // amended to include additional column types and to meet JDBC spec.
120  // Doing "rowset.getObject(_column)" should produce the same result,
121  // possibly since JDBC 2. This is here as a fallback/just-in-case,
122  // given the great divergence in JDBC drivers and database.
123  //
124  // If it turns out that there is some need for flipping, maybe for
125  // different environments, then it's a question of how?
126  //
127  // Explore what things should be flippable and at what granularity.
128  // Should you be able to specify handling per column type?
129  // What switch to flip, in a property file, pluggable, ...
130  //
131  static Object getColumnObject2(RSC comp) throws SQLException {
132    RowSet rs = comp.getRowSet();
133    int cIdx = comp.getColumnIndex();
134    return switch (comp.getColumnJDBCType()) {
135      case INTEGER, SMALLINT, TINYINT -> rs.getInt(cIdx);
136      case BIGINT -> rs.getLong(cIdx);
137      case REAL -> rs.getFloat(cIdx);
138      case DOUBLE, FLOAT -> rs.getDouble(cIdx);
139      case NUMERIC, DECIMAL -> rs.getBigDecimal(cIdx);
140      case BOOLEAN, BIT -> rs.getBoolean(cIdx);
141      case DATE -> rs.getDate(cIdx);
142      case TIME -> rs.getTime(cIdx);
143      case TIMESTAMP -> rs.getTimestamp(cIdx);
144      case CHAR, VARCHAR, LONGVARCHAR, NCHAR, NVARCHAR, LONGNVARCHAR -> rs.getString(cIdx);
145      default -> {
146        logger.log(WARNING, () -> "Unknown data type of " + comp.getColumnJDBCType());
147        yield rs.getObject(cIdx);
148      }
149    };
150  }
151
152  //
153  // Following is available as a fallback if there is an issue.
154  //
155
156  /**
157   * Update the Grid's RowSet at the specified column index with the given Object value.
158   * RowSet. Operate on the current row.
159   * <p>
160   * When the user changes/edits the SSDataGrid cell this method propagates the
161   * change to the RowSet. A separate call is required to flush/commit the change
162   * to the database.
163   *
164   * @param _rowSet RowSet on which to operate
165   * @param _value string to be type-converted as needed and updated in
166   *                      underlying RowSet column
167   * @param _columnIndex   index of the database column
168   * @param type The JDBCType of the column
169   * @throws SQLException  thrown if a database error is encountered
170   * @see <a href="https://download.oracle.com/otn-pub/jcp/jdbc-4_3-mrel3-eval-spec/jdbc4.3-fr-spec.pdf">JDBC 4.3 Specification</a> Appendix B
171   */
172  public static void updateColumnObject2(RowSet _rowSet, int _columnIndex, Object _value,
173                                         JDBCType type) throws SQLException {
174    switch (type) {
175      case INTEGER, SMALLINT, TINYINT -> _rowSet.updateInt(_columnIndex, ((Integer) _value));
176      case BIGINT -> _rowSet.updateLong(_columnIndex, ((Long) _value));
177      case REAL -> _rowSet.updateFloat(_columnIndex, ((Float) _value));
178      case FLOAT, DOUBLE -> _rowSet.updateDouble(_columnIndex, ((Double) _value));
179      case DECIMAL, NUMERIC -> _rowSet.updateBigDecimal(_columnIndex, ((BigDecimal) _value));
180      case BOOLEAN, BIT -> _rowSet.updateBoolean(_columnIndex, ((Boolean) _value));
181      case DATE -> _rowSet.updateDate(_columnIndex, (Date) _value);
182      case TIME -> _rowSet.updateTime(_columnIndex, (Time) _value);
183      case TIMESTAMP -> _rowSet.updateTimestamp(_columnIndex, (Timestamp) _value);
184      case CHAR, VARCHAR, LONGVARCHAR, NCHAR, NVARCHAR, LONGNVARCHAR ->
185        _rowSet.updateString(_columnIndex, (String) _value);
186      default
187          //
188          // TODO: SSSQLExceptionUnhandledType
189          //
190          ->
191        logger.log(ERROR, () -> "Unknown data type of " + type);
192    }
193  }
194
195  private RowSetOps_NOT_USED() {}
196}
